title: Organizer corrects a completed tournament score
description: On a Completed event, enable Correct scores only when none of the players have later matches that changed their ratings. Open a result, change each set count so the other player wins 3 games, confirm the winner change, and save — rankings for this tournament are recalculated.

steps.title: Completed tournaments
steps.body: Open the Completed stage to find finished events. Score correction is only offered here — not while the tournament is still Active.

steps.title: Open the completed event
steps.body: Tutorial Completed Round Robin is seeded with a full results matrix and standings.

steps.title: Final results
steps.body: Standings and the Results Matrix show every recorded match. Correction stays locked until you enable Correct scores.
steps.resultNote: Completed Round Robin results are visible.

steps.title: When correction is allowed
steps.body: Correct scores is available only if none of these players have played any later matches that changed their ratings. A later completed event or a manual rating change blocks correction.

steps.title: Enable Correct scores
steps.body: Tap the wrench (Correct scores). The banner appears and correctable cells get a highlight outline.

steps.title: Correction mode on
steps.body: Highlighted cells are safe to edit under the current eligibility rules. If a later rating event blocked correction, the banner explains why instead.
steps.resultNote: Score correction banner is active with highlighted results.

steps.title: Open a recorded result
steps.body: Click a highlighted score cell (pencil icon). The Match Entry dialog opens with the existing sets (seeded here as 3–1).

steps.title: Existing score
steps.body: Match Entry shows the recorded sets. Change each player’s set count to correct the result.
steps.resultNote: Match Entry is open on an existing completed result.

steps.title: Change the first player’s sets
steps.body: Edit the first player’s set count (here from 3 down to 1 — they will no longer be the winner).

steps.title: First score updated
steps.body: The first player’s sets now show 1.

steps.title: Change the second player’s sets
steps.body: Edit the second player’s set count so they win with 3 games (here 1–3).

steps.title: Winner flipped
steps.body: Sets are now 1–3 — the other player wins with 3 games. Saving will ask you to confirm because the winner changed.

steps.title: Save the correction
steps.body: Confirm with the green checkmark. Because the winner changed, a confirmation dialog appears next.
steps.actionHint: Click the green checkmark to save

steps.title: Confirm winner change
steps.body: Modify Result accepts the new winner. Rankings for this tournament will be recalculated.

steps.title: Score corrected
steps.body: The matrix and standings refresh with 1–3. Rankings (and ratings) for this tournament are recalculated from the corrected result.
steps.resultNote: Completed result updated; rankings recalculated for this tournament.
